verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, abahulīkataṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati abahulīkatā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who haven’t made much of mindfulness of the body haven’t made much of the deathless.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, bahulīkataṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati bahulīkatā”ti.
verses.english: Those who have made much of mindfulness of the body have made much of the deathless.”
